newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's credit to private sector up 1.2 pct in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Peru's credit to private sector up 1.2 pct in Aug.

text.p: Credit from Peru's banking system to the private sector stood at 26.267 billion soles at the end of August, up 1.2 percent from 25.958 billion a month earlier, the Central Reserve Bank said Monday.

Local currency loans to the private sector totalled 7.007 billion soles at the end of August, up 0.2 percent from the month before, while foreign currency loans were $7.829 billion, up 1.6 percent from July.
Bank credit to the private sector stood at 20.082 billion soles at the end of 1995, compared with 13.934 billion a year earlier.
